chunks: ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated to me from ‘Ali ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Īsā ibn ‘Ubayd, from Abī ‘Abdillāh Zakariyyā al-Mu’min, from Ibrāhīm ibn Nājiyah, from Isḥāq ibn ‘Ammār, who said:

I said to Abī ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him), “Teach me a short Salām to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).” He said, “Say: I ask Allāh who selected you, chose you, chose you, guided you, and guided (the creation) through you, to send upon you abundant, delightful blessings.”

key_terms.تَسْلِيماً: A form of greeting or sending peace/salutations
key_terms.خَفِيفاً: Light, concise, or easy to recite

ai.seo_question: What is the short supplication for sending blessings upon the Prophet according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith offers a concise yet profound supplication for addressing the Prophet, emphasizing his divine selection (*intajaba*) and guidance (*huda*). It reflects the Shia emphasis on the spiritual hierarchy of the Prophet, linking his earthly mission directly to Allah’s choice, thereby enhancing the devotional depth of visiting his grave.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 9. ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain narrated to me from ‘Ali ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā ibn ‘Ubayd, from Abī ‘Abdillāh Zakariyyā Al-Mu`min, from Ibrāhīm ibn Nājiyah, from Isḥāq ibn ‘Ammār, who said:

I said to Abī ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)), “Teach me a short Salām to the Prophet (s.a.a.w.).” Imam (a.s.) replied: Recite (the following):                I ask Allāh who selected you, chose you, guided you, and guided (the creation) through you, to increasingly send His delightful blessings on you.
